title: Unregistered Animals in the Apartment Home — Pet Addendum Lease Terms
content:
The Pet Addendum applies the following terms to an animal found living in the apartment home without an approved addendum.

**(a) Recording.** An animal found living in the apartment home without an approved addendum is recorded as an unregistered-animal incident.

**(b) Cure period.** The resident has the cure period of calendar days set for the addendum type the animal would fall under to register the animal or remove it.

**(c) Unauthorized pet fee.** The unauthorized pet fee of the addendum type the animal would fall under posts once per animal, when the incident is recorded.

**(d) Pet rent on later registration.** When the animal is then registered, its pet rent is billed back to the incident date.

**(e) Visiting animals.** A visiting animal is not unauthorized while the addendum type it would fall under allows a visiting animal of that type to stay and it stays no more than that type's number of days a visiting animal may stay.

**(f) Assistance animals.** An assistance animal is never charged an unauthorized pet fee; it is invited to register as an accommodation under the Assistance Animal Accommodation.

## The terms in condition and result form

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| An animal is found living in the apartment home without an approved addendum | An unregistered-animal incident is recorded; the fee of the type the animal would fall under posts once for that animal; the resident has the cure period to register or remove the animal |
| The animal is registered after the incident | Its pet rent is billed back to the incident date |
| The animal is a visitor, its type allows visiting animals, and its stay has not exceeded that type's number of days | It is not unauthorized |
| The animal is an assistance animal | No unauthorized pet fee; an invitation to register as an accommodation |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical addendum type allows visiting animals for up to 7 days. A visiting animal of that type in its 7th day of stay is not unauthorized. On an 8th day the visiting-animal term (e) no longer covers it.
- A hypothetical addendum type does not allow visiting animals. Term (e) does not cover a visiting animal of that type for any length of stay.
- A hypothetical animal found on 3 May and registered afterwards: its pet rent is billed from 3 May, the incident date, not from the date of registration.
- The same animal is recorded again later: the unauthorized pet fee posts once per animal, so it does not post a second time for that animal.
